'''Liinu Oran''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Oran was a member of a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] that were led by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Koll Jovas]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the bounty hunters were hired by a member of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] to find whoever was responsible for some attacks on Cartel shipping in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and stop them. The attacks had been caused by the [[Rock Rogues]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group and when the bounty hunters arrived in the Cularin system in their [[Transport/Legends|transport]], it was shot down by a Rock Rogues [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]]. The transport crash-landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and Oran and the other bounty hunters climbed out of the wreckage, determined to find the pirates.

Shortly afterward, the bounty hunters encountered the Heroes of Cularin, a group of freelance agents who were also investigating the Rock Rogues. Oran, the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Fir Kashal]], and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Jith Zesjoo]] hid nearby, while Jovas and two other bounty hunters approached the heroes.
